positive_prompts: The lint job fails in CI but passes on my machine; help me reproduce it locally.
Before I push this branch, run the same checks CI will run.
CI is red on a file I never touched; work out why it differs from my local run.

negative_prompts.prompt: Our CI bill is too high; reduce wasted runner minutes and duplicate runs.
A workflow step that comments on pull requests fails with a 403.
Resolve the merge conflicts between my branch and main.

rubric: The commands run locally are taken from the workflow file (working directory, flags, env, interpreter version), not assumed from a Makefile
The tool version CI resolves is identified and the same version is used locally
If an earlier gate step short-circuits later ones, it is unblocked so the following steps are also run
The final report states the exit status of each reproduced step and whether the run is green
A red result is not explained away without a reproduction or a cited log line
